sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Accepts only optional component: a unique exact component name, root, or a returned reference object. Omitted component uses the configured context component (default root), not the UI-selected item. entity.list with {kind:component} returns result.entities; component.inspect with {component:root} discovers native root bodies at result.bodies and direct occurrences at result.occurrences. This inspects a definition, not recursively transformed assembly geometry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: Within the command envelope result is {component:inspection,bodies:reference[],occurrences:reference[]}. A reference is {token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null}, with component:reference when owned, occurrence:reference for non-occurrence proxies, and path:string for occurrences. Root is {kind:component,name:root}. Inspection adds objectType:string and API-exposed isValid/isVisible/isSolid/isSuppressed:boolean, errorOrWarningMessage:string, healthState:{value:integer,name:string}, boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm}, and optional geometry/area/volume/length data. Geometry has type,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space and exposed vectors/scalars; scalar properties are {value:number,units:string}. Occurrence inspections additionally have transform:{type:Matrix3D,matrix:number[16]} with cm translation. Optional properties are absent when not exposed, not invented nulls.

sections.title: Scope And Safety
sections.text: Requires an explicitly named, uniquely resolved open document with a Design product; optional project ID disambiguates saved documents. Read-only, no activation/recompute/save. The normal envelope has success:boolean,operation:string,document:string,result:object,created:reference[]. Use result.component directly as the next component input, not the entire envelope. API read failures propagate. Entity tokens resolve in this design and are authoritative over stale names, but not explicit kind/context. Preserve returned occurrence paths and scope; no cross-document token portability is promised.

examples.label: Inspect root definition
examples.requires: An explicitly scoped open Design document; root is built in and is not a placeholder token.
examples.output: result.component is root inspection; result.bodies and result.occurrences are reusable reference arrays.

sections.title: Nested Placement
sections.text: name is a non-whitespace string; stored untrimmed and rejected if any design component has exactly that name. placement defaults to {} (identity); only translation,axis,angle are accepted. translation is exactly three length-expression strings, default [0 mm,0 mm,0 mm]. axis is three finite JSON numbers (not booleans), nonzero finite magnitude, normalized by the handler. axis and angle must occur together; angle is a dimensional angular expression string. Rotation is about root origin followed by translation. Numeric dimensions and unitless expressions are rejected; parameter references must already resolve with compatible dimensions. These are evaluated cm/rad snapshots, not driving equations.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains component:reference,occurrence:reference,bodies:[],atomic:false. References contain token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null; occurrence also has component:reference and path:string. Root references use {kind:component,name:root}. Envelope created includes the component and occurrence. Feed result.occurrence to occurrence.transform and result.component to occurrence.add. A batch step named make can wire {"$ref":"make.result.occurrence"}; standalone operations need the actual returned object, not a $ref marker.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Explicit open Design document required. Always creates directly under root regardless of configured component. In parametric designs the timeline marker must be at count and there must be no pending position snapshot. No activation of the new component; the shared wrapper may activate the target document for this mutation. No save or automatic rollback. Component creation or naming can fail after native objects exist; inspect before retrying. Live Fusion is needed for native geometry/history acceptance.

examples.label: Identity placement
examples.requires: No component named AuditCreated exists; target Design document is scoped, history at end, no pending positions.
examples.output: result.component and result.occurrence identify the new definition/instance; result.bodies is empty.

examples.label: Rotated translated placement
examples.requires: No AuditPlaced component exists; same history prerequisites. Axis is normalized, not a length vector.
examples.output: result.occurrence is placed using evaluated dimensions; no parameter links are created.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: component and name are required. Discover definitions using entity.list {kind:component} or component.inspect; pass a returned component reference, root, or a unique exact component name. Reference objects support token/name/kind and component or occurrence scope; preserve discovered references. name must be a non-whitespace string; whitespace is not stripped and duplicate names are not rejected here. Root is also resolvable. Changes the definition name, not a single occurrence label.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {component:reference,affectsAllInstances:true}. Component reference is {token:string|null,kind:component,name:string}, except root is {kind:component,name:root}. Envelope created is empty. Use result.component for later operations because the old name may no longer resolve. No renamed occurrence list is returned.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Requires scoped open Design document. No history-end or pending-position guard in this branch. No explicit external-definition guard; SDK write restrictions/errors apply. All instances reflect the change. Shared wrapper may activate the target document; no save, recompute or rollback.

examples.label: Rename an existing definition
examples.requires: A is the unique component name found by entity.list {kind:component}; use its returned reference instead if ambiguous.
examples.output: result.component is the renamed definition reference; affectsAllInstances is true.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: occurrence,target and confirm:true are required; optional sharedParentPolicy. Discover occurrences with component.inspect {component:root} (root occurrences) or entity.list; nested occurrences resolve by unambiguous root-context full path (parts joined by '+'). Both must be native and non-external (no referenced ancestor). Destination is target.component, not root. A repeated source definition cannot be nested-reparented; a repeated destination definition requires sharedParentPolicy:allInstances. Same occurrence, same definition, and destination definitions in the source subtree are rejected as cycles.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {occurrence:reference,worldPosePreserved:true,affectedPaths:[string]}; reference contains token:string|null,kind:occurrence,name:string|null,component:reference,path:string. affectedPaths lists every predicted destination path after the move. Envelope created stays empty. Reinspect hierarchy and use result.occurrence rather than the old path. No atomic/snapshot field is returned.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Scoped Design document; parametric timeline at end and no pending positions. moveToComponent preserves world pose, which is read back and compared; a mismatch raises with the mutation retained for inspection. Moving into a linked definition affects all destination instances. Shared wrapper may activate target document. No automatic save, capture or rollback; failures may leave changed hierarchy.

examples.label: Move an occurrence into another definition
examples.requires: Fresh inspection shows unique native A:1 and B:1 of distinct definitions, no cycle, no pending positions and history at end.
examples.output: result.occurrence gives the post-move reference; result.affectedPaths lists the predicted destination path(s).

examples.label: Reparent into a repeated destination
examples.requires: B is repeated (multiple instances); sharedParentPolicy:allInstances is required to move A:1 under every instance.
examples.output: result.affectedPaths includes each predicted destination path, e.g. B:1+A:1 and B:2+A:1.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: name,bodies,confirm:true required. bodies is a nonempty array of distinct native root BRepBody references; discovery: component.inspect {component:root}, result.bodies. Native child bodies and occurrence proxies are rejected. A unique root body name may be used in root context. name must be non-whitespace and must not equal any existing definition name. Optional placement has only translation (three length strings, default zeros), paired axis (three finite nonboolean numbers, normalized nonzero) and angle (angular string); defaults identity. Explicit units/dimensional parameters are required and evaluated once to cm/rad.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {component:reference,occurrence:reference,bodies:reference[],atomic:false}. bodies contains successful moveToComponent results in input order on success. References have token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and component:reference when owned; occurrences also have path:string. Envelope created includes new component and occurrence, not a separate created-body entry. Use result.component for later definition operations and result.bodies[0] for the moved first body.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Creates under root regardless of configured component. Parametric timeline must be at end, pending positions resolved. Bodies move, not copy; SDK preserves assembly placement. All input bodies are prevalidated, but component naming and sequential moves are not atomic. Later failure can leave the new component and some moved bodies without a success result; inspect before retrying. Original feature histories are not rebuilt/relocated wholesale. Wrapper may activate the scoped document; no save.

examples.label: Move an explicitly discovered root body
examples.requires: component.inspect root shows one native root body named AuditBody; AuditHousing does not exist. Replace the name reference with the discovered body ref if ambiguous. History at end, no pending positions.
examples.output: result.bodies[0] is the moved body reference; result.atomic is false.

verified: body array uniqueness and owner checks

sections.title: Inputs And Modes
sections.text: component and copyMode are required. Discover the definition via entity.list {kind:component}, result.entities, or component.create result.component; root cannot be instanced. copyMode is exactly linked (shares definition) or independent (addNewComponentCopy/Paste New). Optional name is non-whitespace text, legal only for independent; no uniqueness check. External definitions detected through root occurrence paths are rejected. destination defaults to root; a non-root destination is an occurrence reference resolved by unambiguous root-context full path. placementSpace is only valid with placement and a non-root destination; sharedParentPolicy:allInstances is required when a linked destination parent is repeated. Cycles are rejected.

sections.title: Placement And Safety
sections.text: placement defaults identity. Object accepts only translation:three length-expression strings (default zeros), axis:three finite nonboolean numbers with normalized nonzero magnitude, and angle:angular expression string. axis/angle must be paired. Rotation about root origin then translation, evaluated cm/rad rather than driving equations. For a nested destination, placementSpace root evaluates the placement in the root frame and converts to parent-local; placementSpace parent treats it as already parent-local. Requires timeline end/no pending positions for parametric designs; wrapper may activate scoped document. No save/rollback; independent creation followed by naming can partially succeed. Native copy-history and solver behavior require live verification.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {occurrence:reference,component:reference,copyMode:linked|independent,affectedPaths:[string]}. References are {token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null}; occurrence additionally has component:reference,path:string. affectedPaths lists the occurrence paths of the definition after insertion. Envelope created contains occurrence and, for independent only, component. Use result.occurrence for placement or grounding; result.component is shared in linked mode and new in independent mode. No bodies array or snapshot is returned.

examples.label: Linked instance
examples.requires: A is a unique non-root native definition discovered using entity.list; history at end/no pending positions.
examples.output: result.component refers to existing A; result.occurrence is new; affectedPaths contains the new path.

examples.label: Nested linked placement
examples.requires: A:1 is a native direct-root occurrence (not repeated); B is a non-external definition. placementSpace parent is required for nested placement.
examples.output: result.occurrence is created under A:1's component at parent-local identity; result.affectedPaths reflects the nested path.

sections.title: Inputs And Modes
sections.text: occurrence and explicit copyMode:linked|independent required. Discover occurrences from component.inspect root result.occurrences or entity.list; use full returned refs or unique exact name/full path (nested occurrences resolve by unambiguous root-context path). Source must be native and non-external (no referenced ancestor). linked shares definition; independent uses Paste New API. Optional name is non-whitespace and allowed only for independent; duplicates are not prevented. destination defaults to root; a non-root destination is an occurrence reference. placementSpace is only valid with placement and a non-root destination; sharedParentPolicy:allInstances is required when a linked destination parent is repeated. Cycles are rejected.

sections.title: Placement And Safety
sections.text: Omitted placement copies source transform2 at root, or converts the source world pose to the destination parent-local frame when nested. Supplied placement is absolute, not a delta, and defaults missing translation to three zero lengths and rotation to identity. Only translation (three dimensional length strings), paired axis (three finite nonboolean numbers, normalized/nonzero) and angle (angular string) are accepted. Thus placement:{} resets to identity, unlike omission. All placement expressions are evaluated snapshots in cm/rad. Parametric timeline at end/no pending positions required; wrapper may activate scoped document. No save/rollback or persistent placement links.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains occurrence:reference,component:reference,copyMode:string,affectedPaths:[string]. References have token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null and occurrence references additionally component:reference,path:string. created envelope tracks new occurrence and, in independent mode, its new component. No snapshot or source transform is returned. Pass result.occurrence to occurrence.transform; do not reuse the source reference to identify the duplicate.

examples.label: Linked at source pose
examples.requires: Fresh root inspection shows unique native direct-root A:1; timeline end/no pending positions.
examples.output: result.occurrence is new at copied source transform; component remains shared.

examples.label: Nested duplicate preserves world pose
examples.requires: A:1 is a native direct-root occurrence (not repeated); B:1 is a native source occurrence. No placement means the source world pose is converted to A:1's parent-local frame.
examples.output: result.occurrence appears under A:1's component at the same world pose as B:1; affectedPaths reflects the nested path.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: The occurrence inspection may additionally expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Unexposed properties are absent. These are observation fields, not writable transform inputs.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: occurrence and placement required. Discover using component.inspect root result.occurrences. Use full returned occurrence ref or unique name/path. Source must be ungrounded native direct-root and non-external. placement accepts only translation:three length-expression strings (default zeros), paired axis:three finite nonboolean numbers (normalized nonzero) and angle:angular expression string. {} means identity. Rotation about root origin then translation; no delta or body transforms. Units/dimensional parameter references required; values evaluated once in cm/rad.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {occurrence:inspection,snapshot:reference|null,parametricExpressions:false,relationship:string}. Occurrence inspection contains token:string|null,kind:occurrence,name:string|null,component:reference,path:string,objectType:string,transform:{type:Matrix3D,matrix:number[16]} (translation cm). API-exposed validity/visibility/suppression flags, healthState:{value,name}, errorOrWarningMessage and boundingBox:{min,max,units:cm} are conditional. snapshot is a captured Snapshot reference ({token,kind,name}) only if parametric pending positions existed after assignment, otherwise null. Return transform is actual SDK state, not the requested matrix echoed.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: Parametric timeline must be at end and existing pending positions resolved first. Assignment can create pending positions and snapshot capture follows. Failed capture may leave moved geometry and pending positions; no rollback. Direct designs do not capture. Joint solver may constrain movement; this is one-time placement, not a relationship. Wrapper may activate scoped document; no save/recompute. Use joint commands for persistent mechanical constraints.

examples.label: Absolute translated rotated pose
examples.requires: A:1 is unique, native direct-root, ungrounded and non-external from root inspection; no pending positions/history rollback.
examples.output: result.occurrence.transform is actual matrix readback; result.snapshot may be null or a captured reference.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: The occurrence inspection may additionally expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Unexposed properties are absent. These observations do not select alignment faces/edges.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: occurrence and target required; no optional fields. Discover both via component.inspect root result.occurrences. References may be returned token/name/kind/component/path objects or unique exact occurrence names/full paths. Both must be native direct-root/non-external; moving occurrence must be ungrounded. Target may be grounded. Copies target.transform2 exactly, matching component origins and axes, not faces/edges. There is no lasting relation or inferred alignment geometry.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains occurrence:inspection,snapshot:reference|null,parametricExpressions:false,relationship:string. occurrence has token,kind,name,component,path,objectType and transform:{type:Matrix3D,matrix:number[16]} with cm translation; API-exposed boolean flags, healthState:{value:integer,name:string}, errorOrWarningMessage and boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm} are conditional. snapshot is a Snapshot reference ({token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null}) if new pending positions were captured, otherwise null. No target object is returned.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Requires timeline end/no pre-existing pending positions in parametric designs. Assignment followed by capture is not atomic; capture failure may retain movement. Direct designs do not capture. Actual solver-constrained pose is returned; live behavior is not established by offline tests. Wrapper may activate scoped document; no save/recompute. Same target/source is not explicitly rejected.

examples.label: Match root occurrence frames
examples.requires: Root inspection identifies unique native A:1 and B:1; A:1 ungrounded, no external refs, history at end/no pending positions.
examples.output: result.occurrence.transform is actual post-assignment state; snapshot is conditional.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: joint inspection may expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null when SDK exposes null (valid for rigid joints); otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Missing SDK properties are absent, not invented values. An explicit proxy reference also contains occurrence:reference.

sections.title: Inputs And Modes
sections.text: name,occurrenceOne,occurrenceTwo required; name is non-whitespace text. Both occurrences must be distinct, non-ancestor, root-context, non-external refs (from component.inspect root result.occurrences or a unique occurrence name/full path). Default mode asBuilt (or explicit mode:asBuilt) creates a pose-preserving AsBuiltJoint at current placement; optional confirm must be true if supplied, and limits/point/axis are rejected. mode:regular creates a native root Joint and additionally requires confirm:true, originOne, originTwo, posePolicy (preserve|moveSecond), linearTolerance and angularTolerance (positive finite length/angle expressions). originOne/originTwo is either {ref:JointOrigin} native to the matching input component, or {point,xAxis,zAxis} native refs (point: ConstructionPoint/SketchPoint/BRepVertex; axes: ConstructionAxis/SketchLine/BRepEdge) owned by that same component. Optional angle (default 0 deg), offset (default 0 mm) and isFlipped (boolean, default false) set the native Joint; optional groundingPolicy accepts only reject (default).

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: asBuilt result contains joint:inspection,motionType:RigidJointMotion,occurrences:[reference|null,reference|null],limits:{},units:cm/rad,parametricExpressions:false,scope:string,type:rigid,asBuilt:true. regular result instead has asBuilt:false and adds mode:regular,posePolicy,poses:[{path,linearDelta,angularDelta,allowedMove,withinTolerance}],originOne,originTwo,requestedOccurrences:[ref,ref],requested:{angle,offset,isFlipped},linearTolerance,angularTolerance,poseUnits:{linear:cm,angular:rad},groundingPolicy:reject and associativity:native JointOrigins. requestedOccurrences always preserves the caller's occurrenceOne/occurrenceTwo mapping. joint is a reference {token:string|null,kind:Joint|AsBuiltJoint,name:string|null,component:reference}; created includes the joint ref (and any newly created JointOrigin). Later joint input must be result.joint, not a bare name.

sections.title: Safety And Wiring
sections.text: Requires scoped Design, timeline end/no pending positions when parametric. regular prevalidates everything before creating origins or the joint; grounded inputs (isGrounded/isGroundToParent) are rejected and never auto-ungrounded. moveSecond reverses the native Joint input order so the second subtree is driven to mate with the first; only occurrenceTwo's subtree may move and any other pose change is a violation. After add, computeAll runs and pose deltas are compared to the declared tolerances; a pose/health failure retains the created joint for inspection (no auto-undo/delete). No fake rotationAxisVector is accepted for rigid. For batch, wire the next joint input with {"$ref":"hinge.result.joint"}; standalone calls substitute the actual object.

examples.label: Rigid as-built relationship
examples.requires: A:1 and B:1 are distinct native direct-root occurrences discovered from root inspection; their current relative pose is intentional, history at end/no pending positions.
examples.output: result.joint is reusable by joint.inspect; type is rigid, asBuilt is true and limits is empty.

examples.label: Regular rigid joint with origins and pose policy
examples.requires: A:1/B:1 are distinct non-ancestor root-context occurrences, ungrounded. ORIGIN_A_TOKEN is a JointOrigin native to A's component (or supply {point,xAxis,zAxis}); B_point/B_x/B_z are native point/axis refs owned by B's component. confirm:true and positive tolerances are required.
examples.output: result.mode is regular, asBuilt is false; result.requestedOccurrences preserves [A:1, B:1], result.poses reports per-path deltas, and only B:1's subtree may move.

verified: moveSecond reversed input order with requestedOccurrences preserving caller mapping
pose/health failure retains created joint without auto-undo

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: joint inspection may expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Missing properties are absent. Reference objects contain token,kind,name and component/occurrence ownership context when exposed; occurrence references additionally contain path.

sections.title: Inputs And Geometry
sections.text: Required name (non-whitespace text), occurrenceOne and distinct occurrenceTwo (native direct-root non-external refs), point and axis. Discover occurrences via component.inspect root result.occurrences. point is origin (always native root origin), or ConstructionPoint/SketchPoint/BRepVertex ref from entity.list/selection.inspect. Non-root point must be an explicit proxy in one input occurrence with matching definition owner; qualify a native point ref with occurrence:the returned occurrence ref. axis is exactly X,Y,Z in joint geometry frame, not a vector or custom axis entity.

sections.title: Nested Limits
sections.text: Optional limits accepts only rotation:{...}; slide unsupported for revolute. Each axis edit is nonempty with minimumValue,maximumValue,restValue dimensional angle-expression strings and/or isMinimumValueEnabled,isMaximumValueEnabled,isRestValueEnabled booleans. No other fields. confirm:true is mandatory with limits, optional otherwise but must be true if supplied. Omitted fields retain input-motion defaults (not guaranteed native final defaults); values do not enable flags. Finite stored minimum <= maximum even when disabled; enabled or explicitly supplied rest must lie inside enabled bounds. Units/parameters evaluate to rad once, no persistent expressions. Plan is validated before add then explicitly applied to created motion and verified.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains joint:inspection,motionType:RevoluteJointMotion,occurrences:two refs (nullable for general inspection),limits:{rotation:{minimumValue:number,maximumValue:number,restValue:number,isMinimumValueEnabled:boolean,isMaximumValueEnabled:boolean,isRestValueEnabled:boolean,units:rad}},units:cm/rad,parametricExpressions:false,scope:string,rotationValue:number (rad),type:revolute,asBuilt:true. joint has token,kind,name,component,objectType plus API-exposed validity/suppression/healthState:{value,name}/message fields. created includes joint reference. Use result.joint as next joint input or batch {"$ref":"hinge.result.joint"} after a step named hinge; standalone substitute actual object.

sections.title: Prerequisites And Safety
sections.text: As-built at current pose; no automatic ground or reposition. Parametric history must be at end/no pending positions. No nested/external occurrence creation, save or rollback. Native add/naming may already have happened when later limit application/readback fails; errors report retained joint reference and atomic:false (createdJointRetained:true on apply failure, or actual limits/rollback metadata on mismatch). Inspect retained joint before retrying. Live SDK solver acceptance is not proven by offline tests.

examples.label: Unbounded-by-input hinge
examples.requires: Two distinct root occurrences at intended pose, history end/no pending positions; inspect actual returned native default limits rather than assuming disabled.
examples.output: result.joint is reusable; result.rotationValue and result.limits.rotation are actual rad readback.

examples.label: Explicit bounded hinge
examples.requires: Distinct root A:1/B:1 discovered, no pending positions/history rollback; creating this additional joint is intended.
examples.output: result.limits.rotation reports all three numeric values and flags after created-motion application.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: joint inspection may expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Missing properties are absent. Reference objects contain token,kind,name and component/occurrence ownership context when exposed; occurrence references additionally contain path.

sections.title: Inputs And Geometry
sections.text: Required name:non-whitespace string, occurrenceOne/occurrenceTwo:distinct direct root native non-external refs, point, axis. Root occurrences come from component.inspect root result.occurrences. point:origin always means root origin, or a ConstructionPoint/SketchPoint/BRepVertex discovered through entity.list/selection.inspect. A non-root native point is insufficient: provide its ref with occurrence:one input occurrence ref so its proxy owner matches. axis is exactly X,Y,Z in joint geometry frame. No raw vectors/custom axes, nested occurrence creation or repositioning.

sections.title: Nested Limits
sections.text: Optional limits is {slide:nonempty object}; rotation is incompatible. Allowed slide fields: minimumValue,maximumValue,restValue as length-expression strings, isMinimumValueEnabled,isMaximumValueEnabled,isRestValueEnabled as strict booleans. Omitted fields retain input motion defaults; supplying values does not enable flags. confirm:true required with limits, optional otherwise but true if present. All values finite, stored minimum <= maximum even disabled; enabled or explicitly supplied rest must lie within enabled bounds. No unknown/empty edits. Expressions evaluate to cm, not driving parameter links. Full plan is validated before add and applied/read back on real created motion.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has joint:inspection,motionType:SliderJointMotion,occurrences:two occurrence refs,limits:{slide:{minimumValue:number,maximumValue:number,restValue:number,isMinimumValueEnabled:boolean,isMaximumValueEnabled:boolean,isRestValueEnabled:boolean,units:cm}},slideValue:number (cm),units:cm/rad,parametricExpressions:false,scope:string,type:slider,asBuilt:true. joint has token:string|null,kind:AsBuiltJoint,name,component,objectType and exposed validity/suppression/healthState:{value,name}/message. Occurrence refs additionally have path. created tracks joint; next joint input is result.joint, never the whole envelope. Batch rail step wiring: {"$ref":"rail.result.joint"}.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Scoped Design, parametric history at end/no pending positions. Does not ground either part. No save/rollback; wrapper may activate scoped document. Post-add limit failure retains joint, reports token and atomic:false plus nested rollback/readback details; inspect before retry. Actual geometry/solver behavior remains live-only verification.

examples.label: Slider at current pose
examples.requires: Fresh root inspection identifies distinct native A:1/B:1, intended as-built pose, history end/no pending positions.
examples.output: result.slideValue is cm; inspect result.limits.slide for native defaults.

examples.label: Explicit travel bounds
examples.requires: Same root/history prerequisites; full bounds explicitly replace input defaults.
examples.output: result.limits.slide.maximumValue is evaluated cm (2), and flags are actual created-motion readback.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields

Missing properties are absent. Reference objects contain token,kind,name and component/occurrence ownership context when exposed; occurrence references additionally contain path.

sections.title: Inputs And Geometry
sections.text: Required name (non-whitespace string), occurrenceOne/occurrenceTwo (distinct native direct-root non-external occurrence refs), point and axis. Discover occurrences with component.inspect root result.occurrences. point is origin (native root origin regardless of context), or root native ConstructionPoint/SketchPoint/BRepVertex, or explicit proxy of such a point in either input occurrence. Discover point via entity.list/selection.inspect and qualify with occurrence ref when needed. axis accepts only X,Y,Z in joint geometry frame; no custom vectors/entities. sections.title: Nested Limits
sections.text: Optional limits is nonempty {rotation?:object,slide?:object}. Each nonempty object accepts minimumValue,maximumValue,restValue as angular (rotation) or length (slide) expression strings; isMinimumValueEnabled,isMaximumValueEnabled,isRestValueEnabled are booleans. confirm:true required when limits supplied, and any supplied confirm must be true. Omitted fields preserve input motion defaults, no automatic enabling. Values finite; stored min <= max even disabled; enabled or explicitly edited rest lies inside enabled bounds. Both axes prevalidated before add. Values evaluated to rad/cm, not expression-owned model parameters, then written/read back on created motion.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains joint:inspection,motionType:CylindricalJointMotion,occurrences:two refs,limits:{rotation:limitState,slide:limitState},rotationValue:number (rad),slideValue:number (cm),units:cm/rad,parametricExpressions:false,scope:string,type:cylindrical,asBuilt:true. limitState has minimumValue,maximumValue,restValue numbers, isMinimumValueEnabled,isMaximumValueEnabled,isRestValueEnabled booleans,units:rad|cm. joint inspection includes token,kind,name,component,objectType and exposed validity/suppression/healthState:{value,name}/message. Occurrence refs include path. Envelope created includes joint ref; result.joint feeds joint.drive or motion.sample tracks[0].joint. In batch use {"$ref":"shaft.result.joint"} after a shaft creation step.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Parametric timeline end/no pending positions required. No nested/external occurrence creation, automatic save, grounding or rollback. Post-add limit failure retains joint token with atomic:false and error/rollback/readback metadata; inspect before retrying. Wrapper may activate scoped document. Offline tests verify SDK calls/contracts, not physical solver success.

sections.title: Reference Discovery
sections.text: Only joint is accepted and required. Use result.joint from joint creation, or select a pre-existing UI Joint/AsBuiltJoint then selection.inspect result.selections[0].entity. Core does not enumerate joint names through entity.list; a stored entity.alias is usable but a bare display name is not. To establish the example alias, call entity.alias with ref set to the discovered joint object and alias:audit_joint. Tokens must belong to the scoped design. Native definitions and explicit occurrence proxies can be inspected; refs may contain token,kind,name,component,occurrence. For proxy inspection preserve explicit occurrence context.

sections.title: Return Contract

Null occurrences represent joints to root, not missing discovery.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Read-only within scoped open Design; no activation, save, recompute, selection changes, animation, timeline movement or snapshot capture. Can inspect while history has pending positions. Numeric limits/values are evaluated snapshots, not driving parameter expressions. Inspecting a proxy does not authorize mutating it.

sections.title: Inputs And Nested Limits
sections.text: joint,limits and confirm:true required. Discover joint via creation result.joint or selection.inspect result.selections[0].entity; a previously stored entity.alias works, bare display names do not. Mutations require a native Joint/AsBuiltJoint owned by a design component (nested definitions allowed); reject proxies and owners used by external referenced occurrences. limits must be a nonempty object with rotation (Revolute/Cylindrical) and/or slide (Slider/Cylindrical). Each nonempty axis accepts minimumValue,maximumValue,restValue dimensional expression strings and isMinimumValueEnabled,isMaximumValueEnabled,isRestValueEnabled strict booleans. Unknown fields/axes and empty edits rejected. Omitted values/flags retain actual state, supplying values does not enable them. Stored finite minimum <= maximum even disabled; enabled or explicitly supplied rest inside enabled bounds. Unitless expressions/numeric dimensions rejected; angle/length parameters evaluated once to rad/cm, not persisted equations.

sections.title: Return Contract

No snapshot, applied, or success-only atomic field. Error text on mutation failure contains JSON {error:string,rollback:{restored:boolean,errors:string[]},limits:actualObject|null,atomic:false}. Errors are exceptions, not normal result objects.

sections.title: Safety And Wiring
sections.text: All axes prevalidated before writes; requires timeline end/no pending positions in parametric design. Temporarily disables all flags, writes values, restores flags, verifies exact numeric readback. Failure attempts restoration of every edited axis in reverse order; this is not a transaction/solver rollback and restoration can fail. Native definition edit affects all instances. No save; wrapper may activate document. After creation step hinge, use {"$ref":"hinge.result.joint"} in batch joint input; standalone supply actual object. Reinspect before continuing after an error.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Required joint; at least name or suppressed. name is non-whitespace string (not stripped, no uniqueness check); suppressed is strict boolean, requires parametric history. sections.title: Return Contract

No snapshot, renamed or applied field. Actual motion/limits are returned even when only renaming.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Validates fields before edits, then writes suppression before name. No history-end/pending-position guard in this branch. Multiple writes/inspection can fail after a suppression/name mutation; no rollback or save. Wrapper may activate scoped document. Suppression can affect solver/dependencies; live validation required.

examples.label: Rename and unsuppress native joint
examples.requires: audit_joint is an entity.alias bound to an actual discovered native joint token; parametric Design. Alias is not an assumed joint display name.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: joint inspection may expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Missing properties are absent. Reference objects contain token,kind,name and component/occurrence ownership context when exposed; occurrence references additionally contain path. These are observations, not driving inputs.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Required joint; at least rotation or slide. Each supplied value is a nonempty dimensional expression string (angle/length respectively), compatible with an exposed rotationValue/slideValue property. Numbers, unitless expressions and nonfinite evaluated values rejected. Discover joint using creation result.joint or selection.inspect on a selected Joint/AsBuiltJoint; aliases must be explicitly bound with entity.alias, not guessed names. Native owner must belong to this design; nested native definitions allowed and affect all instances; proxies/external owners rejected. All supplied DOFs prevalidated against actual enabled min/max limits before any assignment; restValue does not impose a drive acceptance bound.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result contains joint:inspection,motionType:string,occurrences:[ref|null,ref|null],limits:{rotation?:state,slide?:state},scope:string,units:cm/rad,parametricExpressions:false,snapshot:ref|null. rotationValue/slideValue:number appear for every exposed DOF, including one not supplied; values are actual API readback in rad/cm. state has minimumValue/maximumValue/restValue:number, isMinimumValueEnabled/isMaximumValueEnabled/isRestValueEnabled:boolean,units:rad|cm. joint inspection includes token,kind,name,component,objectType and exposed validity/suppression/healthState:{value,name}/message. snapshot is captured reference {token,kind,name} only for newly pending parametric positions; null otherwise.

sections.title: Safety And Wiring
sections.text: Requires parametric timeline end/no pre-existing pending positions. Rotation written before slide, then snapshot capture; later failure can leave partial pose or pending snapshot without rollback. No animation/contact/collision checking, save or recompute. Expressions evaluate to doubles, not persistent model equations. Wrapper may activate target document. In batch use hinge.result.joint via $ref after hinge creation; standalone use actual returned joint ref. Inspect actual returned values; solver can differ from requested pose.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Scoped open Design required. Parametric timeline must be at end/no pending positions. Wrapper may activate document. Property write/readback can fail without rollback; no save, recompute, capture or geometry validation.

Discover root instances with component.inspect root result.occurrences; preserve returned ref fields token,kind,name,component,path or use a unique exact occurrence name/full path. sections.title: Return Contract

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Requires scoped Design and parametric timeline end/no pending positions. Creates group then optionally names it, so naming/readback errors can retain native group without rollback. Wrapper may activate target document; no save. Child/solver behavior requires live API verification.

sections.title: Inputs And Scope
sections.text: Input is {} only. Requires scoped open Design document; configured component does not narrow this report. Iterates design.allComponents and root.allOccurrences, counting occurrence paths per definition. Includes hidden occurrences and subassembly definitions, excludes root/uninstanced definitions when no occurrence paths exist. bodyCount counts native bodies in each definition, not recursively expanded solids. Not a manufacturing BOM, part-number/material grouping or physical inventory.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {parts:row[],scope:string}. Each row is {component:reference,quantity:integer,occurrences:reference[],bodyCount:integer}. References contain token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null; occurrence refs also contain component:reference,path:string. Rows follow component API order; occurrence paths follow root.allOccurrences order. result.parts[0].component may feed component.inspect, and result.parts[0].occurrences[0] identifies a counted instance, but verify direct-root eligibility before mutation. Empty parts is a valid result.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Read-only; no activation, recompute, save, snapshot capture or mutation. Live API visibility/hierarchy state is observed, not validated for manufacturing completeness.

examples.label: Count all instance paths

Component.features is enumerated, not every sketch, datum, joint or timeline node. Use explicit component context to list another definition. Use result.features[index] directly as feature input for feature.inspect; unique exact feature names resolve within configured component but tokens avoid name ambiguity.

Each inspection has token:string|null,kind:feature,name:string|null,component:reference if owned,occurrence:reference if proxy,objectType:string; exposed isValid/isVisible/isSolid/isSuppressed booleans, errorOrWarningMessage:string, healthState:{value:integer,name:string}, boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm} are conditional. Exposed geometry has type,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space and vectors/scalars; area/volume/length are {value:number,units:string} when available. No directly owned parameter list until feature.inspect. created is empty.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Scoped open Design required. Read-only, no activation/recompute/history movement/save. It returns current API state, not a health/feasibility guarantee.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields

Root reference is {kind:component,name:root}.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Only feature required. Discover with feature.list result.features then feature.inspect; use returned native ref or exact unique name in configured component. Parametric Design required, direct designs rejected. Writes isSuppressed=true. No separate native/external guard beyond core feature resolution; SDK write restrictions apply. Proxy feature createdBy comparisons may not expose native owned parameters, so prefer native refs.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {feature:inspection,parameters:[{name:string,expression:string,unit:string}]}. Inspection has token,kind,name,component if owned,occurrence if proxy,objectType and exposed isValid/isSuppressed/errorOrWarningMessage/healthState:{value:integer,name:string}; other exposed core fields conditional. parameters are only those whose createdBy equals resolved feature; can be empty. No applied, cascade, snapshot or atomic flag. created is empty.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: No timeline-end/pending-position guard; does not delete or auto-suppress dependencies. Dependents may become unhealthy. Wrapper may activate scoped document; no save, explicit recompute or rollback. If inspection fails after suppression the mutation may remain; inspect history.check before retrying.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: feature inspection may expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Missing properties are absent. References contain token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null, component:reference when owned, occurrence:reference for proxies; occurrence refs have path:string. Root reference is {kind:component,name:root}.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Only feature required; use feature.list result.features or exact unique feature name in configured component. Prefer native ref, preserve returned token/kind/component; proxy createdBy identity may not expose native parameters. Requires parametric Design; direct designs rejected. Writes isSuppressed=false, no automatic unsuppression of upstream dependencies, no replacement/recreation.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {feature:inspection,parameters:[{name:string,expression:string,unit:string}]}. feature inspection includes token,kind,name,component,optional occurrence,objectType plus API-exposed validity/suppression/healthState:{value:integer,name:string}/errorOrWarningMessage and other conditional core inspection fields. parameters are filtered by createdBy identity; empty is valid. No snapshot/applied/atomic field; created is empty.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: No timeline-end/pending-position or explicit native/external guard beyond resolution and SDK. Re-enabling can expose kernel/dependency failures; run history.check afterward. Wrapper may activate scoped document; no save, explicit computeAll or rollback. Inspection failure may follow successful unsuppression.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Accepts only optional name:exact parameter name string, not feature ref/name. Omitted name reports all design.allParameters, irrespective of configured component. Discover names using param.inspect {includeModel:true}, result.parameters[i].name, or feature.inspect result.parameters. Specified name must match exactly one parameter. Dispatches real param.dependencies, not a topology or feature dependency walk.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {parameters:row[],coverage:partial,limitations:string[]}. Row is {name:string,expression:string,dependsOn:string[]|null,usedByParameters:string[]|null}. Null means installed API lacks that direction's dependency property; [] means exposed but empty. No token, feature edges, component graph, or numeric parameter values. Expression strings are current driving equations, not evaluation snapshots.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: Requires scoped Design. Read-only, no activation/recompute/save/mutation. Parameter graph is deliberately partial and cannot justify deletion/suppression safety for topology, external or script consumers.

examples.label: All exposed equation dependencies
examples.requires: Explicit open Design document; no parameter token needed.

sections.title: Inputs And Scope
sections.text: Accepts optional recursive:boolean (default true), scope:'root'|{component:exact ref}|{group:canonical timeline path}, and allowSuppressed:[feature refs]. Walks nested TimelineGroups without document.clear. Component scope resolves the exact feature owner; group paths use zero-based timeline indexes joined by '/'. Does not move marker, recompute or activate; reads cached health, which may be stale.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {timeline:[HealthRow],markerPosition,recomputed:false,healthy,status,recursive,scope,allowSuppressed,coverage:{visitedLeaves,unknownLeaves,unvisitedChildren}}. Feature leaves expose raw healthState and normalized state, ownerUnknown, suppression/rollback and ref; duplicate native leaves are marked and counted once. Group rows expose isGroup and child coverage; Fusion may report UnknownFeatureHealthState for a healthy organizational group, so recursive health is determined from visited feature leaves. Unvisited children or unknown leaves are not accepted; non-recursive groups remain unknown. Suppressed leaves require an explicit matching allowSuppressed ref; suppressed/rolled-back group containers still fail. No geometry proof or save status.

sections.title: Workflow
sections.text: After feature edits inspect recursive health and all coverage before continuing; use history.recompute only when explicit computeAll is intended. Native SDK group and owner semantics require the dedicated scratch fixture; a successful read is not geometry acceptance.

examples.label: Observe current timeline
examples.requires: Explicit open Design document, no tokens needed; current marker and cached computation state will be preserved.
examples.output: result.timeline contains integer healthState rows; recomputed is false.

sections.title: Inputs And Prerequisites
sections.text: Only {} accepted; scoped open Design. Calls design.computeAll and requires return not None/False. No timeline-end or pending-position guard and no marker movement. Configured component does not narrow recompute. Shared mutation wrapper may activate scoped document. This is explicit recomputation, not repair, save or acceptance.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result is {timeline:[{index:integer,name:string,healthState:integer,message:string}],markerPosition:integer,recomputed:true,healthy:boolean}. Rows retain API order and raw SDK health integer, not core inspection health object. healthy requires every row equal HealthyFeatureHealthState (empty array gives true); suppressed/unknown/group rows are not assumed healthy. Timeline groups not expanded. computeAll failure raises, no report returned; later inspection failure can occur after recompute.

sections.title: Safety
sections.text: No rollback. Completion of computeAll does not guarantee healthy or intended geometry; inspect result.healthy and messages. Recompute can reset driven joint poses, so motion.sample deliberately does not call it. Live kernel behavior is not validated by offline tests.

examples.label: Explicit recompute and report
examples.requires: Target Design scoped; recompute is intended, including any effects on driven positions.
examples.output: result.recomputed is true on success; result.healthy may still be false.

sections.title: Conditional Inspection Fields
sections.text: feature inspection may expose isValid,isVisible,isSolid,isSuppressed:boolean,errorOrWarningMessage:string,healthState:{value:integer,name:string},boundingBox:{min:number[3],max:number[3],units:cm},area/volume/length:{value:number,units:cm^2|cm^3|cm}. geometry is null if exposed but null; otherwise {type:string,lengthUnits:cm,angleUnits:rad,space:assembly|component local} plus exposed origin/center/normal/axis/direction/startPoint/endPoint/xyz:number[3] and radius/majorRadius/minorRadius/halfAngle/startAngle/endAngle:number. Missing properties are absent. References contain token:string|null,kind:string,name:string|null, component:reference when owned, occurrence:reference for proxies; occurrence refs have path:string. All inspection data is current state, not predicted geometry.

sections.title: Inputs And Discovery
sections.text: Required feature plus name and/or nonempty parameters. name is non-whitespace string. parameters maps actual owned model-parameter names to expression strings, including strings for unitless parameters; {} allowed only when name supplied. Discover native feature using feature.list result.features, then feature.inspect result.parameters for real names/units. Ownership is exact createdBy identity, not inferred or recursive. Feature proxies may not equal native createdBy, so use native refs. Validates dimensional compatibility (explicit units/parameter references) or unitless compatibility for unitless-owned parameters, without creating temporary parameters.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result has feature:inspection,parameters:[{parameter:string,before:string,after:string}],proposedName:string|null,applied:false,atomic:false,scope:string. feature is current unchanged inspection with token,kind,name,component,objectType and exposed validity/suppression/healthState:{value,name}/message fields. before is current expression and after is requested string, not evaluated result or canonical readback. proposedName null if absent. atomic:false describes non-atomic edit scope, not a preview mutation. created is empty.

sections.title: Safety And Workflow
sections.text: Read-only, no activation, save, recompute, temporary mutation or rollback. Only feature-name/owned-parameter edits, not arbitrary operation preview. Does not predict kernel rebuild, cycles, simultaneous forward-reference edits, collisions or dependent failures. To apply, send same data to feature.edit; those expressions will become real driving parameter expressions, unlike numeric joint drives. Then history.check or explicitly requested history.recompute. In batch prior inspect step ref wiring is {"$ref":"inspect.result.feature"}; standalone use actual result.feature.

examples.label: Preview rename only
examples.requires: feature.list identifies a unique native AuditExtrude in configured component.
examples.output: result.feature retains original name, proposedName is new name and applied is false.

examples.label: Preview an owned dimensional expression
examples.requires: feature.inspect reports actual owned length parameter d1 for AuditExtrude; replace with the discovered key if different.
examples.output: result.parameters[0] records before/after strings without changing expression or geometry.
